what: áo khoác chống nắng: a woman of Bãi Trước in a light sun jacket with long sleeves and a hood (an order of the person blueprint of World that wears the jacket)
uses: Plan 0026, R10: women on the walk of the sea and on the sand at 17:00, in a sun jacket over a T-shirt.

sources.date: 2019-04-30 (in the file name of the photo)
sources.author: Đông Hà / Tuổi Trẻ
sources.shows: Bãi Trước at the end of the afternoon of a holiday, to the south. A person in a blue jacket with long sleeves and a hood sits on the low wall of the beach: the hood is down on the back, the jacket ends at the hips, the sleeves go to the wrists. The file is a crop of that person.

sources.author: Đỗ Tuấn Hùng / VnExpress
sources.shows: A woman who sells fruit by the low wall of Bãi Trước: a jacket of red and blue checks with long sleeves, a hood that is down on the back, a zip at the front, and a green cloth hat with a wide brim. The file is a crop of the woman.

height_of_person.source: estimate (no source): the person of World with the height 0.42 (a woman of 32 years). The sizes of the jacket scale with the body.

length.source: Photo 0: the hem of the blue jacket is at the hips of the person who sits on the wall. Photo 1: the hem of the check jacket is under the basket, at the hips.

sleeves.source: Photo 0 and photo 1: the sleeves go to the wrists.

hood.source: Photo 0 and photo 1: the hood is down on the back of the neck. Women also wear the hood up on the head (not in these photos): no source.

fit.source: Photo 1: the jacket stands away from the body at the arm and at the side; how much: estimate (no source).

zip.source: Photo 1: a zip from the hem to the neck.

colors.value: blue #4f8fbe; also light blue #7fb7de and checks of red and blue
colors.source: Photo 0: the median color of the jacket in the shade at the end of the afternoon is #184662; in the light of day it is a medium blue: #4f8fbe (estimate of the light). Photo 1: checks of red and blue. The old spec gives light blue from photo 0. One color for each woman.

shirt_under.source: Photos 0 and 1 do not show the shirt under the jacket. At the mid and far levels the jacket covers the body from the neck to the hips. An order with a T-shirt under the jacket (four clothes) stops the builder of the factory (HTTP 503), so the order has no T-shirt.

looks.seen: world_rain_shell in blue #4f8fbe: at the mid level the jacket is a color on the body from the hips to the chin and on the arms to the wrists, as the length and the sleeves of photos 0 and 1. But it is tight (a color on the skin, not a loose jacket), the collar goes up to the chin as a turtleneck, and no hood shows: in photos 0 and 1 the jacket is loose and its hood hangs on the back. The pants show as a dark navy.
looks.changed: No change of the order: the person blueprint has no other jacket with a hood that shows at the mid level (a tool request). Next: the far level.

looks.seen: The far body: the blue jacket from the hips to the chin and on the arms to the wrists, dark pants, brown sandals; the same as the mid level. No hood and no loose cut, as at the mid level.
looks.changed: No change (status Check, a tool request for a jacket with a hood that shows at the mid and far levels).
